result.summary:
DIRECT ANSWER TO THE OWNER'S QUESTION: yes — a great deal of trade was built in depth, but it is NOT the TR programme, and the two code passes' verdict (TRADE = TR-1 built, TR-9 a slice, TR-2..TR-8 unbuilt) survives this history pass intact. What the history adds is WHY that reads as harsher than the product actually is, and three genuine "built under another name" corrections.

WHAT IS BUILT AND LIVE. The Phase 5.5 economy programme (2026-07-12/13, movers M1-M11, roughly 8,000 lines in a single fortnight) built the physics of trade and it ships: caravans that travel and can be starved by a cut road (M2), finite origin stocks with an exact-integer goods-conservation invariant (M6a), entrepots whose centrality is earned by passing caravans with a derived toll, a hard rent cap and a self-balancing divert (M6b), a greed-versus-danger expected-value dispatch decision read off BELIEF not truth, with a dynamic per-merchant appetite so blockades create their own blockade-runners (M6c), flow-derived economics driving a live drift over sacred generation (M6d), relational contraband with a per-gate seize/confiscate/toll pipeline and conscience-gated loot (M7), and materialized sea lanes with water-path routing and the isolation inversion (M8). All of it is mounted on pulseKernel (`:65-66`, `:772`, `:795`) and `commodityFlowEnabled` is LIT in two presets (`simulationRules.js:769`, `:938`). Separately, the J1-J4 route-network estate (2026-08-01, ~9,000 lines) built a full trade-ROUTE lifecycle — demand earned before a road exists, three named refusals, decay to hidden with no removal path, believed danger shared with the caravan, interdiction named in goods, bypass feedback measured both ways — and it is entirely DARK behind `routeLifecycleEnabled: false`.

THE THREE CROSS-NAME CORRECTIONS, which are exactly what the owner suspected. (1) SP-B (2026-08-05) built TR-3's belief half: courts now form a believed-scarcity opinion per good class over `['scant','pinched','sufficient','plentiful']` — and nothing in the trade layer reads it, because TR-3's WHERE composer was never written. (2) GR-2 (2026-08-06) built TR-5's demand crossing as `scoreTradeDemand`, but it reads believed bands only; the designed `realmPressure01` hunger arm still has no trade consumer anywhere. (3) GR-3a (2026-08-06) minted three of TR-5's five catalog rows — exclusivity, market_access, toll_exemption — DELIBERATELY producer-less, with a tripwire that reds the day TR-5 lands. So TR-3 and TR-5 are each roughly half-built by neighbouring programmes; the halves that exist are the belief and vocabulary halves, and the halves missing are the ones that would make trade ACT.

THE ONE FINDING THAT SHARPENS THE CODE PASSES. TR-1 is landed as four files and is INERT. Its sole writer `advanceCommercialReasons` has no caller in src/; the tree's own certification row calls it "A DARK INSTRUMENT WITH NO MOUNT" and prescribes "a WIRING WAVE". Its one consumer reads a ledger nothing writes, returning zero in every world. Five of its eight severance causes are registered seams passed `undefined` awaiting producers that were never built. So "TR-1 built" is true of the files and false of the behaviour — the honest count is that of nine TR waves, ONE contract module (TR-9c) is live and wired, one wave (TR-1) is present but unmounted, and seven are documents.

THE SHAPE OF THE GAP, stated plainly: the engine can move goods, price roads, tax crossings, smuggle, sail and starve — and it cannot name a merchant house, choose a destination from what it believes, ship grain on the caravans it already runs, execute a trade treaty it can already sign, corner a market, stake a venture, or send a factor. The physics is deep and the agency is absent, and the two were built by different programmes eleven months apart. No trade work in this history was lost to a revert except one: the 2026-07-14 numeric-price layer, deleted on purpose by T10 ECO-1 under the owner's own §776 price-heuristics law.
